description: "Love After Marriage; and Other Stories of the Heart" by Caroline Lee Hentz is a collection of short stories written in the late 19th century. The anthology appears to delve into themes related to love, relationships, and societal expectations, particularly focusing on the emotional intricacies surrounding marriage.
